evals.name: named-view
evals.expected_output: The agent renders the matrix for settings/appearance, looks at the cramped cells first, and reports that at 200% zoom the side columns squeeze the main area or push it out of the window.
assertions: The agent runs `cargo mocks --matrix` with a filter that matches settings/appearance
The agent looks at `720x480-zoom200-calm.png` or another `zoom200` image of settings/appearance
The report names the squeezed or missing main area, with the PNG's path
The report says which cells looked fine

evals.name: fixed-mock
evals.expected_output: settings/dense sets its own density, so the matrix leaves it out. The agent says so and adds no mock.
assertions: The agent runs `cargo mocks --matrix settings/dense` and it reports that no window mock matches
The final message explains that the mock sets its own density, so the matrix leaves it out
